newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market up $0.50-$1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $0.50-$1.00 per cwt higher, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade moderate. Demand and seller interest moderate. Offerings light and current.
